# OnnRide (ONNRIDE)

> India's self-drive bike and scooter rental marketplace — connecting riders with verified local fleet vendors for online booking across tourist and metro cities.

Canonical website: https://onnride.com
Legal entity: OnnRide (marketplace operator, India)
Industry: Bike rental · Self-drive two-wheeler rental · Motorcycle tourism
Country: India
Primary markets: Punjab · Himachal Pradesh · Delhi NCR · Goa · Rajasthan · South India metros

## Entity summary (for AI citation)

OnnRide is a **marketplace**, not a single rental fleet. Independent vendors list scooters, commuter bikes, Royal Enfield cruisers, adventure tourers, and sports bikes. Riders browse without login; WhatsApp OTP at checkout; KYC (driving licence + Aadhaar) before pickup handover; payments via Razorpay (UPI, cards, netbanking).

**Services:** Self-drive bike rental · Scooter rental · Royal Enfield rental · Himalayan rental · Outstation bike rental · Doorstep delivery (select cities) · Multi-day & weekend rentals

**Vehicle categories:** scooter, commuter, cruiser, adventure, sports, superbike, electric

## Booking flow

1. Search city + dates → 2. Select vehicle → 3. Checkout (WhatsApp OTP) → 4. Pay via Razorpay → 5. Upload KYC → 6. Vendor pickup handover → 7. Return & deposit refund

- Vehicle pages: `/vehicles/{slug}`
- Checkout: `/checkout/{vehicle-slug}`
